name: DAG Dataflow Runtime
description: Prompt assets for the DAG Dataflow non-linear agent execution runtime. The runtime asks an LLM planner to decompose the task into a JSON dependency graph, executes nodes in topological order with bounded parallelism across independent branches, and synthesizes a final answer from all node outputs. These prompts separate the planner, node execution, and synthesis stages so SDK users can inspect or override any stage independently when constructing DAGDataflowRuntime.
